productPath.workflow: submitMission -> submitMissionDispatch -> writeMissionDispatchRecord -> OpenClaw Gateway -> Workforce projection

product-path-mission-create.detail: Canonical submitMission created and persisted the dispatch; the native Gateway populated runtime identity.

product-path-api-list.detail: Mission list discovered the persisted dispatch and matched detail state from the same snapshot.

product-path-api-detail.detail: Mission detail resolved by dispatch id from persisted sidecar plus current native snapshot.

mission-basic.detail: Real AgentOS submission reached one native session/run and completed with authoritative output.

product-path-idempotency.detail: Replay returned the same persisted dispatch without a second native model completion; altered request identity failed closed.

result-projection.detail: Final output came from the native Gateway result persisted by the canonical Mission workflow and reconstructed in Mission detail.

artifacts.detail: OpenClaw executed the native write tool and Workforce projected the bounded runtime-created artifact.

delegation.detail: The deterministic sessions_spawn attempt completed without an exposed native task/child row; no synthetic delegation was created.

waiting-worker.detail: The exact runtime exposed no native child task to drive this state.

multiple-human-control.detail: Two native questions remained independently pending until both were resolved.

approval-resolution.detail: Native approval was projected, denied safely, and disappeared from the pending inventory.

human-control-product-path.detail: Native Human Control projection and resolution passed, but the safe fixture did not expose a mission-linked task/session request for the AgentOS mutation path. No unrelated approval was relabelled as Mission-linked evidence.

gateway-reconnect.detail: The product-path Mission retained the same exact session key and history across disposable Gateway restart.

agentos-restart-projection.detail: Workforce projection rebuilt from the persisted product-path dispatch and native session after Gateway restart.

cancellation.detail: No native task identity was exposed by this turn, so no unrelated session was cancelled.

child-failure.detail: No native child task was exposed by the safe deterministic turn.
